## Corrections

### 1. [WARN] Performance: Raw `<img>` tags must use next/image
**What's wrong:** Three files use raw HTML `<img>` tags instead of Next.js `Image` component. This skips automatic lazy loading, WebP conversion, responsive sizing, and CDN optimization.
**Files to fix:**
- `src/app/(features)/compare/page.tsx` (line ~106)
- `src/components/features/comparison/comparison-tray-content.tsx` (line ~66)
- `src/components/features/detail/detail-hero.tsx` (line ~35)

**How to fix:**
Import `Image` from `next/image` and replace each `<img>` tag.

**In `src/app/(features)/compare/page.tsx`:**
```tsx
// Before:
<img src={laptop.imageUrl} alt={laptop.name} className="w-full h-full object-contain" />

// After:
import Image from 'next/image'
// ...
<Image
  src={laptop.imageUrl}
  alt={laptop.name}
  width={200}
  height={200}
  className="w-full h-full object-contain"
/>
```

**In `src/components/features/comparison/comparison-tray-content.tsx`:**
```tsx
// Before:
<img src={laptop.imageUrl} alt={laptop.name} className="w-full h-full object-contain" />

// After:
import Image from 'next/image'
// ...
<Image
  src={laptop.imageUrl}
  alt={laptop.name}
  width={80}
  height={80}
  className="w-full h-full object-contain"
/>
```

**In `src/components/features/detail/detail-hero.tsx`:**
```tsx
// Before:
<img ... />

// After:
import Image from 'next/image'
// ...
<Image
  src={laptop.imageUrl}
  alt={laptop.name}
  width={400}
  height={400}
  className="w-full h-full object-contain"
  priority  // Hero image should load immediately
/>
```

**Important:** Since images come from external retailer URLs, add remote patterns to `next.config.ts`:
```typescript
// next.config.ts — add to the existing config:
images: {
  remotePatterns: [
    { protocol: 'https', hostname: '**' },  // Allow all HTTPS image sources
  ],
},
```
Note: Agent 1 owns `next.config.ts` — if you cannot edit it, flag this as a dependency for Agent 1. Alternatively, if it already has image config, skip this step.

### 2. [WARN] TypeScript: `any` cast in deal-card.tsx
**What's wrong:** `src/components/features/deals/deal-card.tsx` line 28 uses `as any` cast for `dealRating`. This hides potential type mismatches.
**Files to fix:**
- `src/components/features/deals/deal-card.tsx`

**How to fix:**
```typescript
// Before (line 28):
dealRating: laptop.dealRating as any, // Cast if enum mismatch, but should match

// After — properly type it:
dealRating: laptop.dealRating,
```

If there's actually an enum mismatch between Prisma's generated type and the component's expected type, fix the component's type definition to match the Prisma enum:

```typescript
import { DealRating } from '@prisma/client'

interface DealCardProps {
  laptop: {
    // ...other fields
    dealRating: DealRating  // Use the Prisma enum directly
  }
}
```

### 3. [WARN] Accessibility: Missing aria attributes in Features B components
**What's wrong:** Detail, comparison, and deals components have no aria attributes. Every interactive element needs one.
**Files to fix:**
- `src/components/features/detail/*` (detail page components)
- `src/components/features/comparison/*` (comparison components)
- `src/components/features/deals/*` (deal cards)
- `src/app/(features)/compare/page.tsx`
- `src/app/(features)/deals/page.tsx`
- `src/app/(features)/budget-picks/page.tsx`
- `src/app/(features)/best-rated/page.tsx`
- `src/app/(features)/laptop/[slug]/page.tsx`

**How to fix:**
Add aria-labels to all interactive elements. Key items:

**Detail page:**
```tsx
// Price comparison links
<a href={price.url} aria-label={`Buy from ${price.retailerName} for ${price.formattedPrice}`} ...>
// Spec table
<table aria-label="Laptop specifications">
// Add to comparison button
<button aria-label={`Add ${laptop.name} to comparison`} ...>
```

**Comparison page:**
```tsx
// Comparison table
<table aria-label="Side-by-side laptop comparison">
// Remove laptop button
<button aria-label={`Remove ${laptop.name} from comparison`} ...>
```

**Deal/Budget/Best-rated pages:**
```tsx
// Page heading region
<section aria-label="Top Deals">
// Deal card grid
<ul role="list" aria-label="Deal listings">
```

**Add metadata exports to each page:**
```typescript
// src/app/(features)/deals/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Top Deals',
  description: 'Best laptop deals right now. Price drops, clearance sales, and limited-time offers from 16+ retailers.',
  openGraph: { title: 'Top Laptop Deals | TopComp', description: 'Best laptop deals right now.' },
}
```

Repeat for `/budget-picks`, `/best-rated`, `/compare`, and `/laptop/[slug]` (dynamic metadata using `generateMetadata`).

For the dynamic laptop detail page:
```typescript
// src/app/(features)/laptop/[slug]/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next'

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }): Promise<Metadata> {
  const laptop = await prisma.laptop.findUnique({ where: { slug: params.slug } })
  if (!laptop) return { title: 'Laptop Not Found' }
  return {
    title: laptop.name,
    description: `Compare prices for ${laptop.name} across 16+ retailers. Specs, reviews, and the best deals.`,
    openGraph: {
      title: `${laptop.name} | TopComp`,
      description: `Compare prices for ${laptop.name} across 16+ retailers.`,
      images: laptop.imageUrl ? [{ url: laptop.imageUrl }] : [],
    },
  }
}
```
